   296	    IsUnit (1 - K) ∧ ‖Ring.inverse (1 - K)‖ ≤ (1 - δ)⁻¹ := by
   297	  have hlt : ‖K‖ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hK hδ
   298	  refine ⟨⟨Units.oneSub K hlt, Units.val_oneSub K hlt⟩, ?_⟩
   299	  rw [NormedRing.inverse_one_sub K hlt]
   300	  have hg := tsum_geometric_le_of_norm_lt_one K hlt
   301	  have hpos : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
   302	  calc ‖((Units.oneSub K hlt)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val‖ = ‖∑' n : ℕ, K ^ n‖ := rfl
